name: day-trader-skill
description: The Day Trader skill pack for Claude, adapted to Borsa İstanbul (BIST)

plugins.name: day-trader-skill
plugins.description: Ten Claude skills for day trading on Borsa İstanbul: a chart scanner, a news monitor, an entry timer, an exit planner with BIST ticks and taban/tavan, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a risk manager, a budget manager with commission and BSMV, an order-slip broker (never places an order, never without your yes), price alerts and an earnings analyst.
